description: This file defines a PHP interface named AuthAttributeBagInterface within the namespace OrangeHRM\Authentication\Dto. The interface specifies methods for managing a collection of authentication attributes, including retrieving all attributes, keys, adding, replacing, getting, setting, checking existence, and removing attributes.

classes.name: AuthAttributeBagInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface that outlines methods for managing a collection of authentication-related attributes.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns an array of all attributes.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an array of all attribute keys.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces current attributes with the provided array of parameters.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates attributes with the provided array of parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute by key, returning a default value if the key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of an attribute for the given key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if an attribute key exists.
